description: This file defines configuration utilities for setting up camera sessions in an iOS app, including adding camera, photo, and movie outputs, as well as handling errors related to camera session setup.

classes.name: CameraSessionConfigurationError
classes.description: An enum defining possible errors during camera session setup, conforming to LocalizedError for descriptive error messages.

classes.name: CameraSessionConfiguration
classes.description: A utility enum with static methods to configure camera session by adding inputs and outputs, including handling audio inclusion and output quality settings.

methods.name: addCameraInput
methods.description: Adds a camera input to the given AVCaptureSession using the specified AVCaptureDevice; throws if adding fails.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput
methods.description: Adds a photo output to the given AVCaptureSession, configures its photo quality prioritization, and returns the created output.

methods.name: addMovieOutput
methods.description: Adds a movie file output to the given AVCaptureSession, optionally includes audio input, sets recording duration, and returns the output.
